indicator_provenance.technical_price_basis: split-adjusted OHLC rescaled to latest raw close
indicator_provenance.atr_formula: Wilder ATR14 seeded with mean(TR1..TR14), then ATR=((prior*13)+TR)/14
indicator_provenance.relative_volume_formula: completed-session volume divided by mean volume of the prior 20 completed sessions
indicator_provenance.ema_direction_formula: (EMA_t - EMA_t-3) / ATR14: rising > 0.10, falling < -0.10, otherwise neutral
indicator_provenance.source_role: unofficial yfinance/Yahoo research data requiring independent session and quote verification
